Many other interfaces ensure easy connection of numerous peripheral components.The new generation of CPU microarchitecture and the integrated Intel UHD Graphics Gen12 with up to 32 execution units, both from the 12th generation Intel Core processors, set new standards in the areas of CPU single-thread/multi-thread performance as well as multimedia and AI. textwithimage.alt: TQMxE41S COM Express® Compact Embedded Module
textwithimage.text:
SMARC 2.1 Module with Intel Atom® processors x7000E & x7000RE Series, Intel® Core™ i3 processors, and Intel® Processors N Series

The SMARC 2.1 module TQMxE41S is available with a wide variety of processors in the power range 6 W to 15 W TDP. It combines high CPU and graphics performance (incl. increased AI acceleration) with a variety of high-speed interfaces such as 2x 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet, 4x PCIe, USB 3.2 and SATA in a very compact design. The high system performance is supported by the latest LPDDR5-4800 memory and up to 256 GB Industrial iNAND eMMC. Many other interfaces ensure easy connection of numerous peripheral components.

The new generation of CPU microarchitecture and the integrated Intel UHD Graphics Gen12 with up to 32 execution units, both from the 12th generation Intel Core processors, set new standards in the areas of CPU single-thread/multi-thread performance as well as multimedia and AI. For the first time in this performance segment, AVX256 and advanced AI instruction sets (VNNI) are also supported, providing fast AI inferencing and media transcoding. Together with the extended security features including TPM 2.0 support, the module is particularly well suited for applications in healthcare, IoT, industry/robotics, retail and video & conferencing.

text.text:
Features

  • Codename: Alder Lake-N & Amston Lake
  • Intel Atom® processors x7000E/RE Series, Intel® Core™ i3 processors, and Intel® Processors N Series
  • One common design from dual-core up to 8-core
  • High efficiency with 6 W to 15 W processor power
  • Up to 16 GB LPDDR5, with In-Band-ECC (option)
  • Up to 256 GB eMMC
  • Three independent high-resolution display outputs including DP++, HDMI and eDP/LVDS
  • Intel® AVX256 and Intel® Deep Learning boost support
  • 2x 2.5 Gigabit ETH, high-speed PCIe and IO
  • Extended security features
  • Extended temperature range and "Industrial Use Conditions (24/7)" available
  • Small size (82 mm x 50 mm)
  • SGeT SMARC 2.1 (RC1) compliant

  • Intel® Core™ i3-N305 (8-Core, 1.8/3.8 GHz, 32 EU, 15 W TDP, PC-Client)
  • Intel® Core™ i3-N305* (8-Core, 1.0/3.8 GHz, 32 EU, 9 W cTDP, PC-Client)
  • Intel Atom® x7425E (4-Core, 1.5/3.4 GHz, 24 EU, RT, 12 W TDP, Embedded)
  • Intel Atom® x7213E (2-Core, 1.7/3.2 GHz, 16 EU, RT, 10 W TDP, Embedded)
  • Intel Atom® x7211E (2-Core, 1.0/3.2 GHz, 16 EU, RT, 6 W TDP, Embedded)
  • Intel® Processor N200 (4-Core, 1.0/3.7 GHz, 32 EU, 6 W TDP, PC-Client)
  • Intel® Processor N97 (4-Core, 2.0/3.6 GHz, 24 EU, 12 W TDP, PC-Client)
  • Intel® Processor N50 (2-Core, 1.0/3.4 GHz, 16 EU, 6 W TDP, PC-Client)
  • Intel Atom® x7835RE (8-Core, 1.3/3.6 GHz, 32 EU, RT, 12 W TDP, Industrial)
  • Intel Atom® x7433RE (4-Core, 1.5/3.4 GHz, 32 EU, RT, 9 W TDP, Industrial)
  • Intel Atom® x7213RE (2-Core, 2.0/3.4 GHz, 16 EU, RT, 9 W TDP, Industrial)
  • Intel Atom® x7211RE (2-Core, 1.0/3.2 GHz, 16 EU, RT, 6 W TDP, Industrial)
Memory

LPDDR5:

  • 4, 8, 16, 32 GB, with In-Band-ECC option

eMMC:

  • 16, 32, 64, 128, 256 GB Industrial iNAND

EEPROM:

  • 32kbit
Graphics

Display:

  • 1x eDP (4K @ 60 Hz) or Dual Channel LVDS (18/24-bit) (assembly option)
  • 1x DP++ (4K @ 60 Hz)
  • 1x DP++ (4K @ 60 Hz) or HDMI (Full-HD @ 60 Hz) (assembly option)
Communications Interfaces

Ethernet:

  • 2x 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet (Intel i226)

USB:

  • 2x USB 3.2 Gen2 (up to 10 Gb/s)
  • 6x USB 2.0

SATA:

  • 1x SATA Gen3 (up to 6 Gb/s) (n/a in PCIe x4 config)
Other Interfaces

PCIe:

  • 4x PCIe Gen3 (up to 8 Gb/s per Lane) (div. configurations)

SPI:

  • 1x eSPI (standard) or SPI (assembly option)
  • 1x SPI (for external UEFI BIOS flash)

I2C:

  • 1x I2C

SMBus:

  • 1x SMBus

UART:

  • 4x Serial port (2x 16550, 2x HS-UART)

GPIO:

  • 14x GPIO, incl. fan-control

MIPI:

  • 2x MIPI-CSI-2 ports (limited SW support)
General

Dimensions:

  • 82 mm x 50 mm

Plug-in System:

  • SMARC 2.1 (RC1)

Temperature range:

  • For x7000RE series: Extended temperature: -40°C - +85°C (DTR +/-110°C Tj CPU)
  • For x7000E / N series: Standard temperature: 0°C - +60°C (DTR +/-70°C Tj CPU)

Power supply:

  • Main Voltage: 4.75 V - 5.25 V / Standby Voltage: 4.75 V - 5.25 V / RTC Battery Voltage: 3 V

Power consumption:

  • typ. 3 - 17 W / max. TBD
OS

OS Support:

  • Windows 10 / Windows 10 IoT Enterprise 2021 LTSC
  • Windows 11 (restricted support)
  • Linux
